{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mark Six sensor beacon''' was produced by [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti United Electronics]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. An immobile, unarmed drone, the Mark Six featured long-range sensors and communication rigs, and was used by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to detect enemies in the vicinity and interfere with hostile ships' systems.
